# Table.PositionOf

```m
Table.PositionOf(table as table, row as record, optional occurrence as any, optional equationCriteria as any) as any
```

Returns the position or positions of the row within the table.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/table-positionof)
